text:
olga-finance: FYI Vendor Eden Energy (vendor_id EE-772) sent INV-PL-3344 dated 2025-06-03. They're charging Polish VAT and a 'gross-up for withholding' line. PO 5279 under Redwood Ltd (GB). Can someone triage?
pedro-procurement: Which entity on the invoice?
olga-finance: Invoice addressed to Redwood Ltd but they put: 'Apply 10% withholding - gross-up +10%'. Snippet:
```Invoice INV-PL-3344
Vendor: Eden Energy Sp. z o.o. (PL)
NIP: PL123-456-78-90
Work: Energy advisory (May 2025) 25h @ 120EUR = 3,000EUR
Gross-up for withholding +300EUR
VAT 23% = 690EUR
Total = 3,990EUR```
nina-legal: Odd. Polish VAT charged to a UK business may be unnecessary if reverse charge applies for B2B services and we provided our VAT. Also 'gross-up' should only exist if contractually agreed. Check SOW/MSA.
tax-bot: Auto-check: vendor country=PL, vendor VAT number looks valid format. PO shows Redwood Ltd VAT GB987654321. Reverse charge likely applies for many cross-border services but depends on service type. Gross-up not standard; no clause found in MSA.
pedro-procurement: Reached out to vendor asking: 1) confirm why VAT added (are they applying domestic VAT?), 2) explain gross-up basis and provide signed amendment if requested, 3) if they withheld taxes at source provide tax voucher. Also asked to reissue clean invoice if reverse charge applies.
ovendor-eden: (vendor reply captured) "We applied VAT by mistake, and our finance team added gross-up to cover a planned local tax deposit. We'll reissue invoice without VAT and remove gross-up unless you accept amendment."
olga-finance: AP flagged INV-PL-3344 ON_HOLD.
ap-bot: Invoice INV-PL-3344 status -> ON_HOLD at 2025-06-04T09:40:00Z.
nina-legal: Keep copies of reissued invoice and any tax certificates if withholding actually occurs. If vendor insists on gross-up, procurement to escalate for commercial decision.
tax-bot: Note for records: If vendor later withholds, request official Polish tax certificate (potwierdzenie zatrzymania) showing withheld amount so we can reconcile.
olga-finance: Draft email sent 2025-06-04 09:12 CET. Will update when reissue arrives.
pedro-procurement: Vendor confirmed 2025-06-04 12:03 CET they'll reissue. Closing here once corrected invoice in AP.
